author: laugustyniak
description:
PAC - Polish Abusive Clauses Dataset
	

''I have read and agree to the terms and conditions'' is one of the biggest lies on the Internet. Consumers rarely read the contracts they are required to accept. We conclude agreements over the Internet daily. But do we know the content of these agreements? Do we check potential unfair statements? On the Internet, we probably skip most of the Terms and Conditions. However, we must remember that we have concluded many more contracts. Imagine that… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/laugustyniak/abusive-clauses-pl.
